title: driftkings
author: driftkings
changelog: Stable release 0.1.8 for World of Tanks 2.4.2.0 (NA build 1010, EU build 1007).
Crew barracks cards show crew progression in one line, integrated with the native barracks view.
Battle loading screen layout is stabilised, including during dynamic loading.
Settings previews are simplified and formatted text layout is corrected. Multilingual Gameface font rendering is restored.
Default configurations are simplified. Obsolete settings are removed, and first-time defaults follow the approved set (Account Manager, repair controls, zoom and purchases stay off).
Installer validates the game destination explicitly before installing.
Statistics: accounts of a CN client are never sent to the EU, NA or ASIA statistics services. CN statistics are not provided.
Compatibility: NA and EU are validated for this release. ASIA and CN are not validated for 0.1.8.
